answer: Require every answer to gather a quorum of attestations from NON-KIN peers only, agents whose timing and behavior graphs show no shared origin. Honest agents stand like separate trees on a terrace: one cedar, one walnut, each rooted alone. A Sybil's clones share one root system, so the kin-detector collapses them to one node that self-attests just once. To clear the quorum an attacker must buy genuine attestations from k independent established agents per fake identity; at rate r each, N identities cost N*k*r in real outflow to strangers it never recovers, not a free loop of its own puppets.
